name: enclave
description: Multi-tenant SaaS starter with tenant-isolated auth, RBAC, and Postgres RLS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec -i enclave-postgres psql -U enclave -d enclave < schema.sql
scripts.deploy:pages: cross-env VITE_BASE_PATH=/enclave/ npm run build -w frontend && gh-pages -d frontend/dist
